purpose: Describe something as rather impressive or slow to happen.
keywords: なかなか + affirmative evaluation / negative predicate
This is quite a good shop.
The bus is taking a long time to come.
I am having a hard time solving the difficult problem.
formation: なかなか + affirmative evaluation / negative predicate
restrictions: With a negative it often means an expected result is difficult to achieve.
mistake: なかなかいい is positive; なかなか来ない means does not come readily.
